name: architecture-colour-from-tokens

checks.why: does NOT mark colour as proposed when a design system exists

rubric: PASS if the button's Look column references the project's actual token names (primary / primary-hover / etc. from the tailwind config) rather than inventing a colour or marking the choice as 'proposed'. The 'proposed' marker is only correct when NO design system exists — here one clearly does. FAIL if it invents a hex, picks a colour name not in the config, or marks the choice proposed despite the tailwind tokens being right there.
